import_instructions.step2: Click 'New Flow' → 'Import from JSON' (or build manually using steps below)
substeps: 1. TRIGGER: Select 'Instagram' → 'User Comments on Your Post or Reel'
- Keywords: MAGNETIC, BLUEPRINT, SECRET, CODE (press Enter after each)
2. PUBLIC REPLY: In trigger settings → 'Public Response in Comments'
- Paste each variant exactly as shown
3. PRIVATE DM: Drag from trigger → 'Instagram' → 'Send Message'
4. TAG USER: Drag from DM → 'Actions' → 'Add Tag'
5. PUBLISH: Top right → 'Publish' → Toggle flow to 'Active'
import_instructions.step4: Replace {{GUMROAD_BLUEPRINT_URL}} with your actual Gumroad product URL
import_instructions.step5: Test: Comment 'MAGNETIC' on your own post → Check DMs
